question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `append?: boolean` to models and `SandboxFsBridge.appendFile?` to Plugin SDK consumers with backend-dependent capability gating?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but accepting a new model-facing parameter and shipped external SDK method determines a long-lived compatibility contract that repository policy reserves for an API owner.

options.title: Sponsor the gated contract
options.body: Approve the optional model and SDK surfaces, require concise Plugin SDK documentation and exact-head green checks, then land this implementation.

options.title: Keep append internal
options.body: Retain native append for core-owned memory or runtime paths but remove the public write parameter and external Plugin SDK method until a broader API design is approved.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the canonical data-loss issue open and close or defer this PR if maintainers do not want append to become a supported tool contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated contract
recommendation.body: Approve the optional model and SDK surfaces, require concise Plugin SDK documentation and exact-head green checks, then land this implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the built-in agent tool contract and the public Plugin SDK surface rather than a narrow implementation detail.
